comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Tip: some quests/discoveries are annoying. If and when a yellow discovery 'star' won't appear using observe, pay attention to your chat window. When it says it looks like something is nearby, you're in range to find it even when the star doesn't show -- just as LeDodu has demonstrated. Cheers.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: All quests in UWO have specific requirements in order to unlock them - fame, port permits, pre-quests, etc.. While inconvenient that R17 discovery skill quests require one member of the fleet to have a Boston skill equipped (and to be in the correct job to enable it), let's be glad it is not like some job quests where ALL fleet members must be in the same job in order to accept the quest.
